description: Defines the PreinstallManagerImplementation class, which implements preinstall management and configuration interfaces, including nested classes for notifications and jobs, with methods for registration, starting preinstall, handling installation status, and configuration.

classes.name: PreinstallManagerImplementation
classes.description: Main class implementing preinstall management and configuration, with nested notification and job classes, managing package installation events and configuration.

classes.name: PackageManagerNotification
classes.description: Notification class for package installer events, particularly app installation status updates.

classes.name: Job
classes.description: Dispatchable job class for asynchronous event handling within the preinstall manager.

methods.name: Register
methods.description: Registers a notification callback for preinstall events.

methods.name: Unregister
methods.description: Unregisters a previously registered notification callback.

methods.name: StartPreinstall
methods.description: Initiates the preinstall process, optionally forcing installation.

methods.name: handleOnAppInstallationStatus
methods.description: Handles app installation status updates received as JSON responses.

methods.name: Configure
methods.description: Configures the preinstall manager with the given service context.

methods.name: createPackageManagerObject
methods.description: Creates the package manager object used for installation management.

methods.name: isValidSemVer
methods.description: Checks if a version string is a valid semantic version.

methods.name: isNewerVersion
methods.description: Compares two version strings to determine if one is newer.

methods.name: readPreinstallDirectory
methods.description: Reads the preinstall directory to list packages.

methods.name: getFailReason
methods.description: Converts a FailReason enum to a string description.
